step1.title: React: The Most Prolific JavaScript Framework
step1.description:
React did not start its life as something that I'd ever think would become one of my favorite JavaScript frameworks. Through initial dislike, begrudging respect, and eventual admiration, I'm going to take you through React's past, present, and future, from the perspective of its least likely fan.
